description: Find device drivers in the catalogue of synths, drum machines, controllers and DAWs. Without arguments it lists them all; `query` keeps drivers whose vendor, name or slug contain every word (e.g. 'korg minilogue'). Returns name, vendor, OSC prefix (slug), kind, source tier and firmware version when the source states one. Pass the slug to list_routes for the full CC/NRPN/SysEx map.

limit.description: Return at most this many drivers.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the vendor, name or slug (case-insensitive).

user_id.description: Your anonymous SynthHub id, if you kept it from an earlier session (see the server instructions). Optional.

name: list_devices

firmware.description: Firmware the source documents; null when it does not say.

id.description: Driver id (path in the catalogue), e.g. 'korg/minilogue'.

slug.description: OSC prefix without the leading slash.

usage_status.description: Hosted server only: trust from usage reports (see get_trust).
